source_text: import 'dart:convert'; import 'dart:io'; import '../publish/post_builder.dart'; Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> runPipeline(String assetsDir, String auditDir) async {print('=== PIPELINE ===\n'); print('--- etapa 1: scanAssets ---'); final groups = await BuildAssetsContent.resolveAssetsContent(assetsDir); print('Groups: ${groups.length}'); print(''); print('--- etapa 2: resolvePostsConfig ---'); final postsConfig = BuildJsonPostConfig.resolvePostsConfig(groups, assetsDir); print('Configs: ${postsConfig.length}'); await BuildJsonPostConfig.savePostsConfigToJson('$auditDir\\posts_config.json', postsConfig); print(''); print('--- etapa 3: resolvePostsContent ---'); final postsContent = await BuildJsonPostContent.resolvePostsContent('$auditDir\\posts_config.json', '$auditDir\\posts_content.json'); print('Contents: ${postsContent.length}'); print(''); print('--- etapa 4: resolveFinalPayload ---'); final postsPayload = await BuildFinalPayload.resolveFinalPayload('$auditDir\\posts_content.json', '$auditDir\\posts_payload.json'); print('Payloads: ${postsPayload.length}'); print(''); await BuildFinalPayload.savePostsPayloadToJson('$auditDir\\post_model_NN_payload.json', postsPayload); print(''); print('--- etapa 5: requestPayload ---'); final requests = postsPayload.map(BuildFinalPayload.requestPayload).toList(); print('Requests: ${requests.length}'); print(''); print('=== PIPELINE CONCLUÍDO ==='); return requests;}
